workflows.name: Curate the signal library
steps: filter the recording library and open the editor
validate and persist a new recording
expose the recording to the route planner
workflows.success: the validated recording appears in the library and remains after reload
workflows.failure: field-level errors prevent invalid or duplicate recordings from being saved
workflows.verification: Playwright creates a recording through the library route and verifies its persisted card

workflows.name: Compose and validate a listening route
steps: select an unplaced recording
place or move it through a state command
recalculate and display site constraints
workflows.success: the recording appears at the target site and updated metrics are visible
workflows.failure: invalid placement is rejected and an actionable constraint message remains visible
workflows.verification: Playwright assigns a recording to a site and verifies placement and recalculated analysis

workflows.name: Resolve evidence quality before release
steps: create a linked quality finding
advance the finding through allowed states
run the release check and freeze a revision-bound snapshot
workflows.success: resolved findings are recorded and a current release can be exported
workflows.failure: illegal transitions, unresolved blockers, or stale revisions prevent release
workflows.verification: Playwright creates, advances, and resolves a finding, then runs the release check

workflows.name: Compare listener scenarios
steps: adjust pace and access controls
derive a non-mutating projection
apply selected planning preferences explicitly
workflows.success: projection metrics update and applied preferences persist
workflows.failure: out-of-range inputs are constrained and baseline state remains intact
workflows.verification: Playwright changes scenario controls and verifies projected duration and applied state

workflows.name: Export a listening-site field checklist
steps: filter findings by a listening site
derive the ordered clip checklist
download the CSV file
workflows.success: the selected site survives reload and the CSV lists every clip in sequence
workflows.failure: an unknown site id produces no checklist download
workflows.verification: Playwright selects a site, verifies the checklist, downloads CSV, and restores the overview

workflows.name: Apply the retention policy
steps: classify publications, import batches, and sites against their retention windows
sweep or individually archive expired material into the archive vault
verify route and finding references still resolve to archived objects
restore archived material and re-earn publication eligibility with a passing readiness check
workflows.success: expired material is archived without breaking references and restored material re-qualifies through a passing readiness check
workflows.failure: records within their retention window cannot be archived and restored content blocks release until re-qualified
workflows.verification: Playwright sweeps expired records, confirms the route still resolves an archived clip, restores an import, and checks the release gate

workflows.name: Synchronize committed workspace state across tabs
steps: persist a revision-guarded command
publish the checksummed workspace record
reload the committed record in another open tab
workflows.success: the second tab shows the committed change without a manual reload
workflows.failure: an invalid checksum falls back to the previous valid record or sample state
workflows.verification: Playwright commits a recording in one tab and verifies it appears in a second tab
